sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11962 of 2021
Applicant :- Ran Vijay Misra @ Dhundram

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Harish Chandra Tripathi,Dharmendra Kumar,Divya Tripathi,Prashan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anand Kumar Yadav,Anand Yadav,Anuj Pandey
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Smt. Prashansha Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arvind Kumar Pandey,
learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Ran Vijay Misra alias Dhundram seeks bail in Case Crime No. 57 of 2021, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471, I.P.C., P.S. Pura Kalandar,
District Ayodhya.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 16.02.2021 against six persons including the applicant alleging that two persons namely Uma Prasad and Kamta Prasad had executed a sale-deed in respect of a piece of land in favour of the informant after taking Rs.
15.50 lacs from him and the applicant had executed another sale-deed in favour of the informant in respect of another piece of land and he had taken Rs. 19.50 lacs from the informant.

The F.I.R.
alleges that all the aforesaid three persons were not owners of the land, regarding which they had executed a sale-deed in favour of the applicant.
4. The investigating officer has submitted a chargesheet against the applicant only and the applicant is languishing in jail since 03.08.2021.

sentences.text: 5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R. contains similar allegations against the three co-accused persons, two of whom have been exonerated by the investigating officer, and that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 03.08.2021, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

8. Let the applicant Ran Vijay Mishra alias Dhundram be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime No. 57 of 2021, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471, I.P.C., P.S. Pura Kalandar, District Ayodhya, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023/A.Nigam  Ran Vijay Misra @ Dhundram vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199231121/
